issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as double, but the solution implementation defines these attributes as int. The template expects students to add attributes following the UML; this mismatch can confuse students about which numeric type to use for student counts and may lead to inconsistent implementations or failing expectations in tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute types consistent across artifacts. Preferably update the problem statement UML to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int (counts are naturally integers), or alternatively change the solution/template to use double and clarify why fractional students would be needed. Ensure the UML, template comments, and solution use the same types so students know which type to implement.
